2607.04487.title: Two Black Boxes, One Solver: Encoder Probing and Decoder Attribution for Neural Multi-Attribute VRP under Hard-Mask and Recourse Decoders
2607.04487.paper_summary: Neural autoregressive solvers for the Multi-Attribute Vehicle Routing Problem (MAVRP) reach competitive cost but offer no per-step justification, a problem when dispatchers must validate, accept, or compare them. We open two complementary black boxes in one protocol. On the encoder side, linear probes, spontaneous-organization metrics, rank-based richness measures, and discovered-direction analyses with intervention validation characterize how the latent represents constraint families at the graph, node, and edge level. On the decoder side, three attribution methods (gradient, integrated gradients, DeepLIFT) feed three reading angles: abductive, contrastive against the best feasible alternative, and counterfactual (smallest input change that switches the action or restores feasibility). Explanations are scored on fidelity, concentration, stability, sanity, and actionability. Across six variants combining three encoders (Attention baseline, Unimp, UnimpMoe) with two decoders (Hard-Mask, Recourse), we find that graph inductive bias improves both representational predictability and decoder sanity, that the Mixture-of-Experts encoder represents constraints in a distributed rather than axis-aligned way, and that the Recourse training regime, not merely its softer mask, produces policies that represent infeasibility usefully, exposing make-feasible counterfactuals that Hard-Mask policies fail to produce even when fed infeasible alternatives externally.
2607.04487.paper_summary_zh: 神經自回歸解決方案對於多屬性車輛路由問題（MAVRP）達到了具有競爭力的成本，但未提供每一步的合理性，這對於調度員在驗證、接受或比較它們時是一個問題。我們在一個協議中打開了兩個互補的黑箱。在編碼器端，線性探針、自發組織指標、基於排名的豐富度測量以及帶有干預驗證的發現方向分析，特徵化了潛在表示如何在圖形、節點和邊緣層面上表示約束家族。在解碼器端，三種歸因方法（梯度、積分梯度、DeepLIFT）提供三種閱讀角度：演繹式、與最佳可行替代方案的對比，以及反事實（最小輸入變化以切換行動或恢復可行性）。解釋的評分基於忠實度、集中度、穩定性、理智性和可行性。在六種變體中，結合了三種編碼器（注意力基線、Unimp、UnimpMoe）和兩種解碼器（Hard-Mask、Recourse），我們發現圖形歸納偏見改善了表示的可預測性和解碼器的理智性，Mixture-of-Experts編碼器以分佈式而非軸對齊的方式表示約束，而Recourse訓練機制，不僅僅是其較柔和的掩碼，產生的政策有效地表示不可行性，揭示了Hard-Mask政策即使在外部提供不可行替代方案時也無法產生的可行性反事實。
2607.04487.author: Sohaib Afifi et.al.
